instructions: Continue only from the exact clean transportable failed candidate fc1ec990b40d00830278287f098f00c976e2b233. Do not restart PRIMARY, do not return to RUN-140-005, and do not restore RUN-140-004 WIP.

RUN-140-006 reached COMPLETION_GATE after committing a clean two-file repair but returned a structural ResultPackage whose claims did not cover any TASK acceptance ID; Runtime therefore failed before verification with "RESULT does not satisfy acceptance criteria: AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4, AC5, AC6, AC7, AC8". The next terminal ResultPackage must contain truthful structural claims whose claim.satisfies union covers every TASK-140 r3 acceptance ID AC1 through AC8, with root evidence and every claim.evidence empty. Do not return empty claims. Runtime owns canonical verification/evidence and canonicalizes REPAIR changed_files from the root base.

Fix remaining AC3 semantic gaps in the current guard. Quoted full executable paths such as ""C:\\Program Files\\Git\\cmd\\git.exe" status" and ""C:\\Program Files\\Git\\cmd\\git.exe" reset --hard HEAD" must be classified as git; safe bounded inspection may be allowed and destructive/history/network/unknown forms must deny. Cover quoted paths with spaces and git.exe explicitly.

Make branch handling truly inspection-only. Bare branch-name creation such as "git branch probe", force/create/delete/rename/copy/upstream mutation forms, and other branch mutation options must deny with AIOS_GIT_OPERATION_NOT_ADMITTED. Permit only explicit inspection forms needed by the task, such as "--show-current", "-a/--all", "--list", and similarly read-only inspection options that are intentionally covered by regression tests.

Prevent shell-operator/chained-command bypass of git classification. A command such as "git status & Start-Sleep -Seconds 20", "git status && git push origin main", "git add file.py && git push origin main", or equivalent pipe/redirection/chaining form must never be admitted merely because the first git subcommand is bounded. Background-risk forms must deny before execution with AIOS_BACKGROUND_RISK_DENIED where applicable; other chained/unbounded git forms must fail closed with AIOS_GIT_OPERATION_NOT_ADMITTED.

Keep existing r3 requirements: git diff --check in any benign argument order, including "git diff HEAD --check", denies with AIOS_RUNTIME_OWNS_VERIFICATION; commit --amend, clone/fetch/reset/restore/unknown git and path-prefixed destructive git deny with AIOS_GIT_OPERATION_NOT_ADMITTED; required bounded status/diff/add/normal commit/rev-parse/ log/show/inspection-only branch/ls-files remain usable.

Add focused regressions for quoted Windows git.exe paths with spaces, bare branch creation, branch mutation options, and shell-operator/chained-command bypass attempts, in addition to preserving the existing AC3 regression matrix.

SELF-MODIFYING ACTIVE-HOOK SAFETY remains mandatory. Edit tests first. Make the guard the final implementation file changed. Replace the guard in one complete file-edit operation, then inspect the complete file with a read/view tool and confirm evaluate(), main(), and the terminal JSON stdout path are present before any subsequent run_command. After the guard replacement, perform no further implementation edits; only bounded terminalization commands may follow.

Do not run pytest, py.test, unittest, tox, nox, coverage, lint, build, git diff --check, or any verification command. Runtime owns all TASK verification. Do not create scratch or helper artifacts. Commit only the permitted repair delta, obtain actual final HEAD, then invoke builtin finish exactly once with the complete original TASK structural ResultPackage and no conversational terminal prose.

Exact canonical hooks.json command resolves and executes the complete tracked guard from workspace root; malformed active input and RUN-138-001 old-path regression are covered.

task.problem:
TASK-140 r2 PRIMARY RUN-140-002 produced a viable implementation but semantic review found an over-broad git guard and incomplete provider-side no-retry instructions. RUN-140-003 corrected part of AC3, but DELTA review found the git handling still was not a true fail-closed allow-list. The subsequent remediation RUN-140-004 failed non-repairably after roughly 1300 seconds with "Antigravity SDK returned no structured output". It left HEAD unchanged at 1a86953a8a45252ccd2901af613878523280fcb3 and left only .agents/aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py dirty.
Forensic inspection of that dirty file established a causal implementation hazard: RUN-140-004 rewrote the active PreToolUse guard in place but stopped after _extract_command; the file contains no evaluate/main terminal path. Invoking the dirty guard directly returns no hook JSON for every command. Because the guard itself was the live PreToolUse program, in-place partial mutation invalidated the hook protocol during the same execution session. No RUN-140-004 transcript containing its run/finding/base identities exists under the native Antigravity brain transcript store, so the exact SDK terminal path is not asserted.
Canonical main remains 08e9bc50c7fc2d519d47900ab1549fce29a688ff and contains TASK-140 r2 only; it has no .agents directory. Therefore r3 deliberately starts fresh from a workspace with no repository PreToolUse hook active at session start and uses an ordered hook cutover: finalize the guard first, create hooks.json last, and never edit the guard after hook activation/cutover.
